description: Start a checkout (an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout session) with the products and quantities the user wants. Returns the session id, the cart and its total. If you have no api_key yet, leave it out: a sandbox key is created and returned — reuse it in every later call.

api_key.description: Sandbox key from create_checkout (not needed if the connection already carries one).

buyer_email.description: The buyer's email, if the user gave one.

items.description: Products to buy, by product_id from list_products.

name: create_checkout
title: Create a checkout
